title: Example 120: a Retry-After rewrite proved equal with the unchanged refill helpers taken as one function
description: Regression proof (B9) of RetryAfter#nanosUntilToken in Crosscut between the committed version and the patched one, which rewrites credited + period - now as period - (now - credited) around two unchanged calls into TokenBucket. The two helpers each divide a 64-bit difference by the period; the new shared-callees step of jvmcontract equivalence (lib/src/shared.rs) takes a callee both versions call unchanged as one function in both, through a generated memo stub, so the solver never bit-blasts the divisions. By hand the proof took 1.3 s; without sharing the [-100000:100000] search stage had not finished after 60 s. The job runs build.py on the example, which compiles both versions with javac and runs jvmcontract equivalence.
expected: Verdict verified; the proof line ends with '2 callees unchanged in both versions and taken as one function in both: TokenBucket.lastAfter, TokenBucket.tokensAfter' and the example's result.json records it
